    end

    local pid = healing_target:GetPlayerOwnerID() or -1
    local s = PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
    if not s then return keys.heal end
    local health = s.Health
    if health and health > 0 then
        print("[Heal]", healing_target.heal_percent)
        return health * healing_target.heal_percent
    end
end

function damage_system:ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)
    local is_monster = attacker:GetTeamNumber() == DOTA_TEAM_NEUTRALS

    if is_monster then
        return Monster_ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)
    end

    local pid = attacker.GetPlayerID and attacker:GetPlayerID() or -1
    local s = PlayerStats:GetDisplay(pid)

    if not s or not victim or victim:IsNull() then return keys.damage end

    ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- 获取标签（attack/skill/projectile）
    ----------------------------------------------------------
    local label                        = victim.hit_label or "attack"
    local pure_pct                     = victim.pure_percent or 0
    local additional_lifesteal         = victim.lifesteal

    victim.hit_label                   = nil

    local source_damage                = 0
    local atk                          = s.game_final.Attack
    local final_damage                 = s.game_final.FinalDamagePct
    local base                         = victim.base_damage or 0
    local career_damage_bonus_pct      = victim.career_damage_bonus_pct or 1
    local career_crit_chance_bonus_pct = victim.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct or 0

    if label == "attack" then
        -- 普攻：（攻击力 + 普攻增伤）* 普攻增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.AttackDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.AttackDamagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat) * pct * final_damage
    elseif label == "projectile" then
        -- 弹幕：（攻击力 + 弹幕增伤 + 弹幕固伤）* 全弹幕增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.ProjectileDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.ProjectileDamagePct or 0
        local scale = victim.damage_scale or 1
        source_damage = ((atk * scale) + flat + base) * pct * career_damage_bonus_pct * final_damage

        DebugPrint("Label  ", label, "  atk  ", atk, " scale ", scale, "  flat  ", flat, "  base  ", base, "  pct  ", pct,
            "career_damage_bonus_pct  ", career_damage_bonus_pct, " final_damage  ", final_damage,
            "  source  ", source_damage)
    elseif label == "skill" then
        -- 技能：（攻击力 + 技能固伤）* 技能增幅 * 最终伤害
        local flat = s.game_final.SkillDamageFlat or 0
        local pct = s.game_final.SkillDmagePct or 0
        source_damage = (atk + flat + base) * pct * final_damage
        print("[Skill Damage]", atk, flat, pct, source_damage)
    end

    if source_damage < 0 then
        source_damage = 0
    end

    local crit
    if label ~= "skill" then
        pct = math.floor(BpToFlat(s.game_final.CritChangePct))
        pct = pct + career_crit_chance_bonus_pct
        pct = math.max(0, math.min(pct, 100))

        crit = RollPseudoRandomPercentage(pct, DOTA_PSEUDO_RANDOM_CUSTOM_GENERIC, attacker)
        if crit then
            local flat = s.game_final.CritFlat or 0
            local mul = BpToRatio(s.game_final.CritMulPct or 0)
            source_damage = (source_damage + flat) * mul
        end
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 纯粹攻击
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local pure_damage = source_damage * pure_pct
    local after       = source_damage - pure_damage
    -- print("[Damage Calc]", source_damage, pure_damage, after)

    local flat        = s.game_final.PureAttackFlat or 0
    local pct         = s.game_final.PureAttackPct or 0
    pure_damage       = (pure_damage + flat) * pct

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 护甲 / 魔抗计算
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    if label == "skill" then
        after = damage_system:ComputeMagicalAfterResist(attacker, victim, after, s)
    else
        after = damage_system:ComputePhysicalAfterArmor(attacker, victim, after, s)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 吸血
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    local lifesteal_pct = s.game_final.LifeSteal or 0
    if lifesteal_pct > 0 then
        attacker:Heal(lifesteal_pct, nil)
    end

    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    -- 伤害金币
    ----------------------------------------------------------------
    reward_system:OnDamage(attacker, victim)

    if pure_pct > 0 then
        -- print("[Damage]", after, pure_damage, pure_pct)
    end

    local final = after + pure_damage

    if additional_lifesteal and additional_lifesteal > 0 then
        local heal = final * additional_lifesteal
        if heal > 0 then
            -- print("[additional_lifesteal]", additional_lifesteal, heal)
            attacker:Heal(heal, nil)
        end
    end



    if final > 0 then
        if crit then
            SendOverheadEventMessage(nil, OVERHEAD_ALERT_CRITICAL, victim, final, nil)
        else
            SendOverheadEventMessage(nil, OVERHEAD_ALERT_DAMAGE, victim, final, nil)
        end
    end

    return final
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具：物理减伤（自带护甲穿透）
----------------------------------------------------------------
function damage_system:ComputePhysicalAfterArmor(attacker, victim, base_phys_damage, atk_stats)
    --SafePrintEntity(victim)

    if base_phys_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local armor = victim:GetPhysicalArmorValue(false) or 0

    -- 护甲穿透（攻击方）
    local pierce = 0
    if atk_stats then
        pierce = atk_stats.game_final.ArmorPierce or 0
    end

    local armor_eff = armor - pierce

    -- Dota 物理减伤公式：0.06 * armor / (1 + 0.06 * armor)
    local reduction = 0
    if armor_eff >= 0 then
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 + 0.06 * armor_eff)
    else
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 - 0.06 * armor_eff) -- 负护甲增伤
    end

    local after = base_phys_damage * (1 - reduction)
    return after
end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- 工具：魔法减伤（带自定义魔抗）
----------------------------------------------------------------
function damage_system:ComputeMagicalAfterResist(attacker, victim, base_mag_damage, atk_stats)
    if base_mag_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local resist = victim:Script_GetMagicalArmorValue(false, nil) or 0

    if resist > 0.95 then resist = 0.95 end
    if resist < -0.99 then resist = -0.99 end

    local after = base_mag_damage * (1 - resist)
    return after
end

    end

    end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then

    end
    return nil

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)

                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                if base_value ~= nil then
                    local base = tonumber(base_value)
                    if base == nil then
                        return nil
                    end
                    return base + numeric
                end
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

        return nil
    end

local function NormalizeList(raw)

local function NormalizePanoramaImagePath(raw)

        return ""

local function GetListValueAt(raw, index)

local function GetItemFieldValue(kv, key, level)

local function SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, key, raw, level, base_value)

local function ResolveSourceKey(name, hero_name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    if (name == "attack" or name == "ranged_attack") and hero_name and hero_name ~= "" then

local function ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, raw_item_name)

local function CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)
    local slots = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return slots
    end

    local base = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, "ProjectileName", level)
    if base and base ~= "" and base ~= "none" then
        table.insert(slots, { name = base, context = "Projectile" })
    end

    for i = 1, 8 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        if item_kv[key] == nil and i > 2 then
            -- stop scanning once we are past the default slots and no explicit key exists
            if i > 3 then
                break
            end
        end
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(slots, { name = val, context = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix })
        end
    end

    return slots
end

local function CollectItemSources(item_kv, level)
    local list = {}
    if not item_kv then
        return list
    end

    local hero = item_kv.HeroName
    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, level)) do
        local src = ResolveSourceKey(slot.name, hero)
        if src and src ~= "" and src ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, src)
        end
    end

    local function push(key)
        local val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        if val and val ~= "" and val ~= "none" then
            table.insert(list, val)
        end
    end

    push("PassiveName")
    push("PassiveSP")
    push("PassiveSP2")
    for i = 3, 6 do
        push("PassiveSP" .. tostring(i))
    end
    push("AbilitySP")
    push("ModifierSP")

    return list
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if not cfg then
        return nil
    end
    local targets = NormalizeList(cfg.Projectile)
    if #targets == 0 then
        return 1
    end
    for i, name in ipairs(targets) do
        if tostring(name) == tostring(projectile_name) then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        local resolved = SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)

        print("[Shop1Enhance] override", prefix, tostring(projectile_name), tostring(raw),
            "base", tostring(base_value), "result", tostring(resolved))
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value("ProjectileDamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)
        local prefix = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number(prefix .. "BaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value(prefix .. "DamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value(prefix .. "PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if IsEmptyValue(val) then
            return key
        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"
end

local function ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, level, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg or not item_kv then
        return
    end

    local additional_list = NormalizeList(cfg.AdditionalProjectile)
    for i, name in ipairs(additional_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key, slot_idx = GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            local suffix = (slot_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(slot_idx)

            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileLevel, i),
                level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Interval",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileInterval, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "Range",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileRange, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "BaseDamage",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileBaseDamage, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "DamageScale",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalProjectileDamageScale, i), level)
            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "PurePercent",
                GetListValueAt(cfg.AdditionalPurePercent, i), level)
        end
    end

    local passive_list = NormalizeList(cfg.Passive)
    for i, name in ipairs(passive_list) do
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            local slot_key = GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, item_level, overrides)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key, name, level)
            SetOverride(overrides, slot_key .. "Level", GetListValueAt(cfg.PassiveLevel, i), level)
        end
    end

    local ability_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.AbilitySP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(ability_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "AbilitySP", ability_sp, level)
    end

    local modifier_sp = GetListValueAt(cfg.ModifierSP, 1)
    if not IsEmptyValue(modifier_sp) then
        SetOverride(overrides, "ModifierSP", modifier_sp, level)
    end

    SetOverride(overrides, "LifestealSP", GetListValueAt(cfg.LifestealSP, 1), level)
end

local function BuildEffectList(cfg, level, prefix)
    if not cfg then
        return {}
    end
    local name_key = prefix .. "Name"
    local names = NormalizeList(cfg[name_key])
    if #names == 0 then
        return {}
    end

    local list = {}
    for i, raw_name in ipairs(names) do
        local name = tostring(raw_name or "")
        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
            table.insert(list, {
                name = name,
                interval = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "Interval"], i), level),
                range = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "Range"], i), level),
                base_damage = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "BaseDamage"], i), level),
                damage_scale = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "DamageScale"], i), level),
                heal_percent = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "HealPercent"], i), level),
                pure_percent = ResolveEnhanceValue(GetListValueAt(cfg[prefix .. "PurePercent"], i), level),
            })
        end
    end

    return list
end

local function ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end
    local effects = BuildEffectList(cfg, level, "Effect")
    local additional = BuildEffectList(cfg, level, "AdditionalEffect")
    if #effects == 0 and #additional == 0 then
        return
    end

    overrides.__effect_overrides = overrides.__effect_overrides or {
        replace = {},
        additional = {},
    }

    if #effects > 0 then
        for _, entry in ipairs(effects) do
            table.insert(overrides.__effect_overrides.replace, entry)
        end
    end
    if #additional > 0 then
        for _, entry in ipairs(additional) do
            table.insert(overrides.__effect_overrides.additional, entry)
        end
    end
end

local function GetEnhancePassiveKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhancePassiveKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance Passive"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance Passive"]
    end
    return kv
end

local function GetLocalizeVariablesSection(section)
    local kv = LocalizeVariablesKV or {}
    if not section or section == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return kv[section] or {}
end

local function ParseMappingToken(token)
    if type(token) ~= "string" then
        return nil, nil
    end
    if token == "" then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local prefix = "ability:"
    if string.sub(token, 1, #prefix) == prefix then
        return string.sub(token, #prefix + 1), "ability"
    end
    return token, "value"
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceKV()
    local kv = Shop1EnhanceKV or {}
    if kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"] then
        kv = kv["Shop1 Items Enhance"]
    end
    return kv
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not name or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV()
    return kv and kv[name] or nil
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildSourceIndex()
    self.source_index = {}
    local kv = self:GetEnhanceKV() or {}
    for name, cfg in pairs(kv) do
        local sources = NormalizeList(cfg and cfg.Source)
        for _, src in ipairs(sources) do
            local key = tostring(src)
            if key ~= "" then
                self.source_index[key] = self.source_index[key] or {}
                table.insert(self.source_index[key], name)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)
    if not source_key or source_key == "" then
        return {}
    end
    return self.source_index[source_key] or {}
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return 1
    end
    local stacks = tonumber(cfg.Stacks or 1) or 1
    if stacks == -1 then
        return -1
    end
    if stacks < 1 then
        stacks = 1
    end
    return stacks
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
    local id = tonumber(self.config and self.config.shop_item_id) or 2
    if id < 1 then
        id = 2
    end
    return id
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.GetCurrentPrice then
        return 0, nil
    end
    local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
    return mgr:GetCurrentPrice(id), mgr
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ConsumeEnhancePrice(pid)
    local price, mgr = self:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    if price <= 0 then
        return true, price, mgr
    end
    local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
    if gold < price then
        return false, price, mgr, gold
    end
    PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
    if mgr and mgr.items then
        local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
        local cfg = mgr.items[id]
        if cfg then
            cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
        end
    end
    return true, price, mgr, gold
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:CanStartSelection(pid, opts)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return false, "invalid"
    end

    local force_unlocked = opts and opts.force_unlocked
    if not force_unlocked and not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return false, "locked"
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state then
        return false, "state"
    end

    if state.selection then
        return false, "busy"
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return false, "empty"
    end

    return true, "ok"
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg)
    if not cfg then
        return false
    end
    return tonumber(cfg.Open or 0) == 1
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources)
    if not item_sources or not cfg_sources then
        return false
    end
    for _, src in ipairs(cfg_sources) do
        local target = tostring(src)
        if target ~= "" then
            for _, item_src in ipairs(item_sources) do
                if tostring(item_src) == target then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    self:BuildSourceIndex()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)

    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if stacks ~= -1 then
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        if purchased >= stacks then
            return false
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, source_key)
    local changed = false
    for _, name in ipairs(self:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)

    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then
        return false
    end

    local kv = Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name]
    if not kv then
        return false
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local changed = false
    for _, src in ipairs(CollectItemSources(kv, lvl)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, src) or changed
    end

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, lvl)
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false
    local applied_extra = {}

    for enhance_name, count in pairs(state.purchased or {}) do
        if count and count > 0 then
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
            if self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
                local cfg_sources = NormalizeList(cfg.Source)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources) then
                    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
                    local enhance_level = (stacks == -1) and count or math.min(count, stacks)
                    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, lvl)) do
                        ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, slot.context, slot.name, item_kv, lvl)
                    end
                    if not applied_extra[enhance_name] then
                        ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, item_kv, lvl)
                        ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, enhance_level)
                        applied_extra[enhance_name] = true
                    end
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides
end

local function BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level, enhance_name)
    local vars = {}
    if not cfg then
        return vars
    end

    local enhance_map = GetLocalizeVariablesSection("shop1_items_enhance.txt")
    local map_count = 0
    for _ in pairs(enhance_map) do
        map_count = map_count + 1
    end
    if map_count == 0 then
        print("[Shop1Enhance] localize map empty", tostring(enhance_name), tostring(LocalizeVariablesKV))
    else
        print("[Shop1Enhance] localize map size", tostring(enhance_name), map_count,
            "ProjectileInterval=>", tostring(enhance_map.ProjectileInterval))
    end
    for source_key, token in pairs(enhance_map) do
        if source_key ~= "__default__" then
            local mapped_key, mode = ParseMappingToken(token)
            if mapped_key then
                local raw = cfg[source_key]
                if raw ~= nil and raw ~= "" then
                    if mode == "ability" then
                        local name = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
                        if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
                            vars[mapped_key] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(name)
                        end
                    else
                        local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayText(raw, level)
                        if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
                            vars[mapped_key] = val
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function merge_passive_vars(name)
        if not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
            return
        end
        local kv = GetEnhancePassiveKV()
        local entry = kv and kv[name]
        if not entry then
            return
        end
        local passive_map = GetLocalizeVariablesSection("shop1_items_enhance_passive.txt")
        local default_mode = passive_map["__default__"]
        for k, v in pairs(entry) do
            local token = passive_map[k]
            if token == nil and default_mode == "*" then
                token = tostring(k)
            end
            local mapped_key, mode = ParseMappingToken(token)
            if mapped_key and vars[mapped_key] == nil then
                if mode == "ability" then
                    local name = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(v, level)
                    if not IsEmptyValue(name) then
                        vars[mapped_key] = "#DOTA_Tooltip_Ability_" .. tostring(name)
                    end
                else
                    local val = ResolveEnhanceDisplayText(v, level)
                    if val ~= nil and val ~= "" then
                        vars[mapped_key] = val
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local function merge_list(raw)
        local list = NormalizeList(raw)
        for _, name in ipairs(list) do
            merge_passive_vars(tostring(name))
        end
    end

    merge_list(cfg.Passive)
    merge_list(cfg.AbilitySP)
    merge_list(cfg.ModifierSP)
    merge_list(cfg.Item)

    return vars
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name) or {}
    local level = 1
    if pid then
        local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        level = purchased + 1
        if stacks ~= -1 then
            level = math.min(level, stacks)
        end
        if level < 1 then
            level = 1
        end
    end

    local display_name = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_name"
    local display_desc = "#shop1_enhance_" .. tostring(name) .. "_desc"

    local payload = {
        ability = name or "",
        image = NormalizePanoramaImagePath(cfg.Image),
        display_name = display_name or "",
        display_desc = display_desc or "",
        display_desc_vars = BuildEnhanceDescVars(cfg, level, name),
    }

    if payload.image == "" and name and name ~= "" then
        payload.image = "s2r://panorama/images/spellicons/" .. name .. "_png.vtex"
    end

    return payload
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:StartSelection(pid, opts)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local force_unlocked = opts and opts.force_unlocked
    if not force_unlocked and not self:IsUnlocked(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or state.selection then
        return
    end

    local pool = state.pool_list
    if not pool or #pool == 0 then
        return
    end

    local temp_pool = {}
    for i, name in ipairs(pool) do
        temp_pool[i] = name
    end

    local choices = {}
    local count = self.config.choice_count or 3
    local item_source = opts and opts.item_source

    local function GetWeightedValue(enhance_name)
        local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
        local weight = GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
        if item_source and ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, item_source) then
            weight = math.min(weight * 2, 1000)
        end
        return weight
    end

    if item_source and #temp_pool > 0 then
        local matching = {}
        for _, name in ipairs(temp_pool) do
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
            if ItemSourceMatchesName(cfg, item_source) then
                table.insert(matching, name)
            end
        end
        if #matching > 0 then
            local name = PickWeighted(matching, GetWeightedValue)
            choices[1] = name
            for i = #temp_pool, 1, -1 do
                if temp_pool[i] == name then
                    table.remove(temp_pool, i)
                    break
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for i = 1, count do
        if choices[i] ~= nil then
            goto continue
        end
        if #temp_pool > 0 then
            local name, idx = PickWeighted(temp_pool, GetWeightedValue)
            choices[i] = name
            if idx then
                table.remove(temp_pool, idx)
            end
        else
            choices[i] = nil
        end
        ::continue::
    end

    state.selection = {
        choices = choices,
    }

    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if player then
        local payload = {
            player_id = pid,
            choice_count = count,
            title = "#shop1_enhance_pick_title",
            choices = {},
        }

        for i = 1, count do
            local name = choices[i]
            if name and name ~= "" then
                payload.choices[i] = self:BuildChoicePayload(name, pid)
            else
                payload.choices[i] = {
                    ability = "",
                    image = "s2r://panorama/images/hero_selection/empty_hero_card_png.vtex",
                }
            end
        end

        CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_show", payload)
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ClearSelection(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if state then
        state.selection = nil
    end
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SendClose(pid)
    local player = PlayerResource:GetPlayer(pid)
    if not player then
        return
    end
    CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(player, "shop1_enhance_close", {
        player_id = pid,
    })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local price, mgr = self:GetCurrentEnhancePrice(pid)
    local gold = PlayerResourceExt:GetAmount(pid, "gold")
    if gold < price then
        print("[Shop1Enhance] not enough gold, need", price, "have", gold)
        return
    end

    local ok = self:CanStartSelection(pid)
    if not ok then
        return
    end

    if price > 0 then
        PlayerResourceExt:AddAmount(pid, "gold", -price)
        if mgr and mgr.items then
            local id = self:GetEnhanceShopItemId()
            local cfg = mgr.items[id]
            if cfg then
                cfg.buy_count = (cfg.buy_count or 0) + 1
            end
        end
        if mgr and mgr.SyncToClient then
            mgr:SyncToClient()
        end
    end

    self:StartSelection(pid, { force_unlocked = true })
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    local pid = event.PlayerID
    local idx = tonumber(event.choice_index or -1)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return
    end

    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not state.selection then
        return
    end

    if idx < 1 then
        return
    end

    local choice = state.selection.choices and state.selection.choices[idx]
    if not choice or choice == "" then
        return
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(choice)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        self:ClearSelection(pid)
        return
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, choice) + 1
    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased > stacks then
        purchased = stacks
    end
    self:SetPurchasedCount(pid, choice, purchased)

    if stacks ~= -1 and purchased >= stacks then
        self:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, choice)
    end

    -- Unlock derived enhances chained by Source
    self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, choice)

    self:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)

    self:ClearSelection(pid)
    self:SendClose(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:ApplyEnhancementsToPlayer(pid)
    local mgr = Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[pid]
    if not mgr or not mgr.RefreshItemsForEnhance then
        return
    end

    mgr:RefreshItemsForEnhance()

    if mgr.SyncToClient then
        mgr:SyncToClient()
    end
end

    end
    local cfg = GetCareerConfigTable(career)
    local dist = origin and (enemy:GetAbsOrigin() - origin):Length2D() or 0
    local is_boss = IsBossUnit(enemy) and 1 or 0
    if not cfg then

    end

    local career_key = string.lower(career)
    if career_key == "warrior" then
        local range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_range", "BonusRange", "Range", "range" }) or 0
        local pct = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if range > 0 and dist <= range then
            bonus = pct
        end
    elseif career_key == "ranged" then
        local min_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_min_range", "BonusMinRange", "MinRange", "min_range" }) or 0
        local max_range = ReadCareerNumber(cfg, { "bonus_max_range", "BonusMaxRange", "MaxRange", "max_range" }) or 0
        local max_bonus = ReadCareerPct(cfg, { "bonus_pct", "BonusPct", "BonusPercent", "bonus_percent", "BonusDamagePct", "bonus_damage_pct" }) or 0
        if max_range > min_range and dist > min_range then
            local t = math.min(1, (dist - min_range) / (max_range - min_range))
            bonus = max_bonus * t
        elseif dist >= max_range and max_range > 0 then
            bonus = max_bonus
        end
    elseif career_key == "control" then
        local requires_boss = ReadCareerBool(cfg, { "requires_boss", "RequiresBoss", "BossOnly", "boss_only", "IsBoss", "is_boss" })
        if requires_boss == 0 then
